name: cascade-select
title: Cascade Select
description: A hierarchical select with cascading panels for drilling down through nested options, e.g. Region > Country > City.

props.name: allowParentSelection
props.description: Whether parent (branch) items can be selectable

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether the cascade-select should close when an item is selected

props.name: defaultHighlightedValue
props.description: The initial highlighted value of the cascade-select when rendered.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the cascade-select when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the cascade-select when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the cascade-select is disabled

props.name: form
props.description: The form attribute of the underlying input element

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Function to format the display value

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: highlightedValue
props.description: The controlled highlighted value of the cascade-select

props.name: highlightTrigger
props.description: What triggers highlighting of items

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the cascade-select elements. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the cascade-select is invalid

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the cascade-select should loop focus when navigating with keyboard

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether to allow multiple selections

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute of the underlying input element

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the cascade-select

props.name: positioning
props.description: The positioning options for the cascade-select content

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the cascade-select is read-only

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the cascade-select is required

props.name: scrollToIndexFn
props.description: Function to scroll to a specific index in a list

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the cascade-select

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onHighlightChange
events.description: Called when the highlighted value changes

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Called when the open state changes

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Each level of the `items` tree opens a new panel as you drill down.

examples.title: Default value
examples.description: Pass `value` as a list of path arrays to select a leaf on mount.

examples.title: Disabled items
examples.description: Mark an individual item `disabled` to skip it in navigation and selection.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Pass `disabled` to disable the whole control.

examples.title: Compound (attr tags)
examples.source:
import CascadeSelect from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/cascade-select/cascade-select.marko";

<CascadeSelect placeholder="Select a fruit" label="Fruit">
  <@option value="apple" label="Apple"/>
  <@option value="banana" label="Banana"/>
  <@option value="cherry" label="Cherry"/>
  <@option value="durian" label="Durian" disabled/>
</CascadeSelect>
examples.description: Use `<@option>` attribute tags for a flat list of options instead of `items=`. Attribute tags don't recurse into children — use `items=` for real trees.
